steps.text: Web extension registry: `framework/core/extensions.ts` = Kotlin `module/Extensions.kt` (`ExtensionPoint`, `Contribution`, `ExtensionRegistry` with declare/contribute/list/listeners, `ExtensionPoints` with the same ids `axf.actions` … `axf.event-descriptors`); exported from `core/index.ts`; `rt.extensions` on `AxfRuntime`.

Web placeholders: `NotImplemented` answers for undeclared capabilities (`rt.capability(id)` → placeholder record with reason), same shape as the kernel's `placeholder(id)`; `framework/react/library.ts` `installLibraries` routes `provides` into the registry so a library can declare its own points.

Fixture: `spec/fixtures/extensions.json` (declare order, contribution order by `order` then insertion, single vs multiple points, placeholder answers) generated from the TS reference; Kotlin `ConformanceTest` replays it (written without a compiler; check the CI issue).

Topological start order on web: `orderLibraries` (already in `library.ts`) becomes the shared `startOrder(modules)` used by both ports' rules (cycle = error listing members), fixture cases added; `installLibraries` reports `missing` + `cycles`.

Python port: `framework/python/axf/extensions.py` (`ExtensionRegistry`, standard points, placeholders) replacing the `MemoryKernel` stand-in in `library.py`; `axf compile-library` smoke test uses it; fixture replay test `framework/python/axf/test_extensions.py`.
Services: typed service registry on web (`rt.services.register/get` with `service:<cap>` names as `plugin-inventory@1` uses) + Python; inventory engine reads providers from it; one fixture case.

Docs + status: `framework/spec/PORTING.md` section "Extension points on every port", plan ports web/python → built, `status.json` features for the epic's capabilities, `tracker.mjs`, `build_step complete`.

Template + console: `react-ts`/`next-ts` templates and the console register one custom extension point each (proves "add modules without rebuilding the kernel"); console tsc + vite build; CI template sweep passes.

Web `AxfStore` in `framework/core/state/store.ts` mirroring Kotlin `state/Store.kt` (reducer, middleware chain, undo/redo, `StatePersistence` over the settings store); unit cases in a new fixture `spec/fixtures/state.json` (reduce, middleware order, undo).

Web `QueryClient` in `core/state/query.ts` = Kotlin `data/QueryEngine.kt` (stale-while-revalidate, `Freshness`, `QueryOptions`, dedupe in-flight, persistence hook); fixture section `query` with fake timers encoded as explicit clock values.
Web `EventBus` (`core/state/events.ts` = `event/EventBus.kt`: topics, replay buffer, typed kernel events) wired to the runtime's existing `on()`; fixture section `events` (replay count, ordering).

Web `FeatureFlags` + `Config` (`core/state/flags.ts`, `config.ts` = `flags/FeatureFlags.kt`, `config/Config.kt`: layers DEFAULT/MANIFEST/REMOTE/ROLE/USER/KILL_SWITCH and DEFAULTS/MANIFEST/REMOTE/USER/OVERRIDE, precedence); manifest `flags`/`config` read at `createAxf`; fixture sections.

Web migrations ledger + semver (`core/state/migrations.ts` = `migrate/Migrations.kt`: `Migration`, `MigrationRunner`, ledger in settings, `Semver` compare, `Deprecations`); the console's one-time saved-defaults migration moves onto it; fixture section `migrations`.

Kotlin conformance: `StateConformanceTest` replaying `state.json` against the existing kernel classes (adjust kernel behaviour only where the fixture exposes a real divergence; note each in the commit); written without a compiler.
React hooks: `useStore`, `useQuery`, `useFlag`, `useConfig` in `framework/react/state.ts`; the console's Plan view uses `useQuery` for `plan.json` as the first consumer; tsc + vite build.
Docs + status: PORTING.md section, plan web port → built (python stays planned), status.json + tracker, `build_step complete`.

Web kit contract: `framework/core/uikit.ts` = Kotlin `contract/UiKit.kt` (`ComponentKind` list from `ui-port.mjs` `COMPONENT_KINDS`, `UiKitSpec`, `UiKitResolver` with fallback to the default AmberX kit + terminal note per missing kind); fixture `spec/fixtures/uikit.json` (resolve, fallback, note text).

React kit registry: `framework/react/kits/index.ts` with the built-in `amberx` kit (today's components mapped by kind) and `registerKit(spec, impl)`; `AppShell`/`Controls` resolve each kind through the resolver instead of importing components directly.

ui-kit asset wiring: the active `ui-kit` asset (already an asset type on Android) picks the kit on web too; Settings → Appearance → UI kit drop-down (both ports share the setting key); rolls exclude it (`rollDefaults.never`).

Second kit (proof): `framework/libs/kit-mui` skeleton via `axf new-library kit-mui --template ui-kit --ports web` with 6 kinds (BUTTON, TEXT_FIELD, SWITCH, CARD, DIALOG, TOAST) on MUI reading only `--fx-*` tokens (THEMING.md); missing kinds fall back and are listed in the Output terminal.
Kotlin parity check: `UiKitConformanceTest` replaying `uikit.json` against `UiKitResolver`; `check-theme.mjs` covers `libs/kit-*`.
Python placeholder: `framework/python/axf/uikit.py` resolver replaying the fixture (Qt Widgets kit stays planned, a placeholder capability `axf.uikit.qt`).
Docs + status: PORTING.md "UI kits", plan web → built, status.json + tracker, `build_step complete`.

Design check (no code): read `contract/Plugin.kt` (PACK/MODULE/SCRIPT, scopes, `PluginLoader`), `framework/schemas/asset-pack.json` if asset-browser made it, and the plugin-catalog format; write `_claude/memory/docs/plugin-runtime.md`: what a PACK may carry (assets, action macros, string packs), install sources (file, URL, QR, console catalog), grants UI, and what stays placeholder (MODULE code loading, SCRIPT).

Pack format on every port: `framework/schemas/plugin-pack.json` (`pack@1`: manifest plugin@1 + files list + hashes) validated by TS (`core/plugins-pack.ts`), Kotlin (`PluginManifest` + pack reader) and Python (catalog engine); fixture `spec/fixtures/plugin-pack.json` (good pack, over-scope pack refused, bad hash).

Android loader, PACK only: `axf-platform-android` `PackLoader implements PluginLoader` — stage from file/URL (OkHttp, no redirects, size cap), verify hashes, keep under `filesDir/plugins/<id>/`, states STAGED→DISABLED→ENABLED; `axf.plugins` placeholder replaced for PACK, MODULE/SCRIPT still answer NotImplemented.

Android apply: an enabled pack registers its assets into `AssetRegistry` (origin = plugin id, conflicts reported as diagnostics) and its macros into `ExtensionPoints.MACROS`; disable/uninstall removes exactly those; unit test with a fixture pack.

Grants: scopes requested vs granted stored in KV; a pack asking beyond `PACK_MAX` is BLOCKED; Settings → Plugins (lib-settings) shows each pack with its scopes and an Enable switch; `PluginManagerModule` lists packs via `PluginInventoryHost`.

Sources: `ExtensionPoints.PLUGIN_SOURCES` gets two contributions — local file picker and console catalog (`GET /api/plugin-catalog?kind=pack` through the console client in lib-hub or a plain URL setting); QR stays placeholder.

Web loader: `framework/libs/plugins` (web `PackLoader`: fetch pack JSON, validate, register assets/macros into `rt`, enable/disable persisted in settings); the console installs it; Settings → Plugins lists packs beside libraries.

Catalog publish for packs: `plugin-catalog.mjs` kind `pack` (files = asset JSON only, validated by `validateAsset`), console Plugin Manager → Install view lists packs; `check-plugin-catalog.mjs` cases.
Tests + CI: Kotlin `PackLoaderTest` (fixture pack, hash refusal, scope block, remove leaves nothing), web unit via `check-plugin-pack.mts`, CI lines; written without a compiler for the Kotlin part.

Docs + status: PORTING.md "Plugins after install", plan android placeholder → built (PACK), web → built, status.json + tracker, `build_step complete`; MODULE/SCRIPT remain placeholders (named in the tracker).

Web contract: `framework/core/work.ts` = Kotlin `contract/Work.kt` (`WorkSpec`, `WorkConstraints`, policies, states, `WorkRegistry` of workers by id); fixture `spec/fixtures/work.json` (unique + KEEP/REPLACE/APPEND rules, backoff computation, constraint evaluation with explicit inputs).

Android scheduler: `axf-platform-android` `WorkManagerScheduler` mapping `WorkSpec` → WorkManager requests (constraints, backoff, unique work policy), `WorkRegistry` dispatch inside one `AxfWorker`; capability `axf.work` real; periodic + one-shot; progress through `WorkState` flow. Written without a compiler.

Web scheduler: `framework/libs/work` with a `setTimeout`/visibility-aware scheduler (one-shot + periodic while the page lives, persisted queue in settings so a reload re-enqueues), constraints evaluated with `navigator.connection`/battery where available, else ignored with a terminal note.

Workers registry: `ExtensionPoints.WORKERS` typed (`WorkerContribution {id, run}`) on Kotlin + web; the alerts library's 3-minute poll becomes the first web worker; Android console showcase registers a demo periodic worker (logs a line).
Tests: Kotlin `WorkConformanceTest` (fixture) + `WorkManagerSchedulerTest` with `WorkManagerTestInitHelper`; web `check-work.mts`; CI lines.
Docs + status: PORTING.md "Background work", plan android placeholder → built, web → built, features `k.scheduler`/`dv.bg` built, tracker, `build_step complete`.

Web contract: `framework/core/session.ts` = Kotlin `contract/Session.kt` (`Principal`, `Session`, `SessionState`, `SessionProvider`, `AnonymousSession`, `AuditEntry`, `AuditLog`, `MemoryAuditLog`); `rt.session` replaces the ad-hoc principal in `runtime.ts` (`bindPrincipal` keeps working, built on it); fixture `spec/fixtures/session.json` (state transitions, audit cap).

Audit log everywhere: every UAC-denied action, swap, settings write of a locked key and bound-principal refusal records an `AuditEntry` (web + Kotlin, same action names); Settings → Account & security → **Audit** list (last 100) in `libs/settings` and Android `SettingsScreen`.

Real provider, axHub: `lib-hub` gets `AxhubSessionProvider` (web: `/api/me` + hub cookie; Android: the AXHub app's cookie-jar sign-in) mapping hub role/perms → `Principal`; the console's `account.tsx` reads `rt.session` instead of its own fetch; first non-mock provider.

Kotlin: `AuthProviders` extension point typed (`AUTH_PROVIDERS` → `SessionProvider`), `lib-accounts` picks the first registered provider (mock stays as fallback module `lib-accounts-mock`); `SessionConformanceTest` replays the fixture; written without a compiler.

Persistence: session survives restart (Kotlin KV `<key>:session` minus secrets; web settings), `EXPIRED`/`LOCKED` transitions on expiry and app lock (lib-lock hooks `LOCKED`); fixture cases for expiry.
Tests + CI: `check-session.mts`, Kotlin test, console `test_wall_users.py` unchanged; CI lines.
Docs + status: PORTING.md "Session + audit", plan android/web partial → built, status.json + tracker, `build_step complete`; warning "No real sign-in provider yet" cleared.

Scope note first: `_claude/memory/docs/libs-core.md` — for each of admin, accounts, profile, billing: what the Android placeholder has (`lib-admin`, `lib-accounts`, `lib-profile`, `lib-billing` screens + modules), what "real" means per port (accounts = axHub provider from `x.session`; billing = provider interface only, Play Billing as a separate library per the plan's recommendation), the web library ids (`ai.amberx.axf.<name>`).

Web lib-logging: `framework/libs/logging` (`AxfWebLibrary`: log sinks via `ExtensionPoints.LOG_SINKS`, levels, the Output terminal as default sink, Settings → General → Logging group) matching `lib-logging` on Android; `axf init` web templates install it beside settings.

Web lib-accounts: `framework/libs/accounts` (Account view = today's `react/studio/AccountView.tsx` moved into the library, sign-in/out through `rt.session` providers, Settings → Account group); the console installs it.

Android lib-accounts real: `AccountsModule` consumes `AUTH_PROVIDERS` (from `x.session` step 4), `AccountScreen` shows the provider's principal, sign-in/out, errors; mock provider moved to `lib-accounts-mock`; `lib-accounts` unit test with a fake provider.

Profile: `lib-profile` Android (`ProfileScreen` edits display name/avatar stored per principal in KV, exported through a `ProfileProvider` interface) + web `framework/libs/profile` (same provider interface, avatar widget uses `avatar` widget kind); contract in `core/profile.ts` = Kotlin `contract/Profile.kt`.

Admin: `lib-admin` Android + web `framework/libs/admin`: an admin-only view (UAC `admin.*`) listing modules/libraries (plugin-inventory), audit log, flags toggles (`x.state` flags), feature kill switches; hidden entirely without the role.

Billing: provider contract `core/billing.ts` = Kotlin `contract/Billing.kt` (products, entitlements, purchase flow result, restore), `BILLING_PROVIDERS` typed; `lib-billing` Android with a `NoBilling` provider (entitlements empty) and `SubscriptionScreen` driven by the provider; web `framework/libs/billing` same; Play Billing library parked as a plan feature (`x.lib.billing.play`).
Fixtures + Kotlin tests: `spec/fixtures/libs-core.json` (profile validation, billing entitlement rules, admin role gate) replayed on both ports; written without a compiler.
Templates: `axf init` installs logging + accounts + profile on web/Android by default (settings already is), build options unchanged; CI template sweep + `axf validate` on the generated apps.

Catalog + status: `libraries.json` entries for the six on web/android/python(planned), status.json features `a.admin`, `u.accounts`, `p.profile`, `b.subs` → built (billing = contract + NoBilling), tracker, `build_step complete`.
Console: Settings → Account & security uses lib-accounts/profile; Standards → nothing changes; console tsc + vite build; theme-swap script passes on the new views.
Docs: PORTING.md "Core libraries", CLAUDE.md Status bullet, `_claude/memory/docs/libs-core.md` finished with what stayed placeholder (Play Billing).

Plan the port (no code): `_claude/memory/docs/python-port.md` — engines in fixture order (theme → layout → components → UAC → actions → hide/spacing/roll/search → banner/widgets), package layout `framework/python/axf/engines/`, dataclasses mirroring the Kotlin models, how fixtures are replayed (`framework/python/axf/spec/replay.py`), what the PyQt6 layer covers in the first slice.

Fixture replay harness: `framework/python/axf/spec/replay.py` loads every `spec/fixtures/*.json`, dispatches by fixture name to a registered engine, reports pass/fail per case; CI job `python-port` runs it (allowed to skip unported engines, listed).
Asset model + validator: `axf/asset.py` (envelope dataclass, `validate_asset` from `asset-types.json` incl. `attach`/`widgets` hosts, slot checks) replaying `validation.json`.
Theme engine: `axf/engines/theme.py` (color + style compile, spacing scale, opacity tokens) replaying `theme.json` + `spacing.json`.
Layout engine: `axf/engines/layout.py` (`compile_slots`, `region_accepts`, hidden regions) replaying `layout.json`, `layout-slots.json`, `hide.json`.
Components engine: `axf/engines/components.py` (component styles, toolbar/nav/app-menu style inputs, container collapsible, toolbar collapsible) replaying `components.json`.
UAC + actions: `axf/engines/uac.py`, `actions.py` replaying `uac.json`, `actions.json`, `menu-filter.json`.
Roll + search engines: `axf/engines/roll.py`, `search.py` replaying `roll.json`, `search.json`.
Banner + widgets engines: `axf/engines/banner.py`, `widgets.py` (host registry, kinds rules) replaying `banner.json`, `widgets.json`.
Runtime: `axf/runtime.py` (registry, swap, settings store, hidden slots, attachments, bound principal, session from `x.session`) with the same action ids; smoke test registering the starter assets.
Project gate: `axf/project.py` validator replaying `project-manifest.json` (same rules file), used by the pyqt6 template's guard.

PyQt6 shell, part 1: `axf/qt/shell.py` — window with banner, menubar (app-menu), toolbar, nav (side list), content region from the compiled layout; theme tokens → Qt stylesheet via a token→QSS compiler.
PyQt6 shell, part 2: dialogs/popups, context menu, settings window driven by `SettingsGroup`s (lib-settings python), search bar widget, clock widget; hot-swap re-applies QSS live.
Qt Widgets kit: `axf/qt/kit.py` implementing the `ComponentKind` table on QtWidgets through the uikit resolver (`x.uikits` python placeholder becomes real).

Template `pyqt6`: `framework/templates/pyqt6` (`template.json`, `project.manifest.json`, `main.py`, `requirements.txt`, guard), `axf init --template pyqt6` wired in `build-engine.mjs` (bakes `framework/python/axf` + assets); `axf validate` on the output.
Tests + CI: replay harness must pass every fixture (no skips left), `python -m pytest framework/python` job, template sweep includes pyqt6 (no display: `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen` smoke).
Docs + status: PORTING.md "Python port", plan python ports → built across epics touched, status.json + tracker, `build_step complete`; `axf init` README lists the template.

Real-library trial: run `axf import-ui --name Cupertino --kit cupertino --source git --path <compose-cupertino repo>` into a scratch android-compose app (`/tmp`), read `tokens.map.json`, list what the codemod missed (patterns + counts) in `_claude/memory/docs/uiport-trial.md`.

Codemod fixes from the trial: extend `ROLE_MAP`/`guessToken` in `framework/cli/ui-port.mjs` for the missed Compose patterns (e.g. `MaterialTheme.colorScheme.x`, `Modifier.padding(Nn.dp)` → space tokens), unit cases in `framework/spec/check-uiport.mjs` (new; fixture snippets in `spec/fixtures/uiport/`).

Kit overrides: generated `kit-<id>` module gets per-kind override files from the library's components (mapping table in `tokens.map.json` → `components.map.json`), default components kept where unmapped; the ui-kit asset lists `covers`.
Web side: `import-ui` for npm libraries (MUI first) generating `framework/libs/kit-<id>` from the `ui-kit` library template with the same maps; `check-theme.mjs` passes on the output.
CI + status: `check-uiport.mjs` in `android.yml` (node job) + the existing fake-lib import sweep; plan warnings cleared, status.json + tracker, `build_step complete`.

Web hot reload: `framework/react` `useDevServer(url)` long-polls `/events` from `dev-server.mjs` and re-registers changed assets (`registry.register` + `rt.refreshFromSaved`); `axf dev` prints the URL; demo app opts in with `?axfDev=`.

Android end to end on the emulator (CI): `rebuild-shots.yml`-style job step that starts `axf dev --framework` on the runner, points the emulator at `10.0.2.2:7070` (setting `axf.devServer`, flag `axf.hotReload`), edits a theme file, screenshots before/after and asserts the pixel diff > 0.

Robustness: dev server validates every changed file before announcing it (invalid → `/events` carries `error` and the device shows a terminal line), ignores editor temp files, handles rename/delete; `check-dev-server.mjs` test with a temp folder.
Docs + status: README section "Live reload on a phone" (PC IP, same Wi-Fi), plan warning cleared, status.json + tracker, `build_step complete`.
BRETT says go (rule: not until he does) and picks the dependency style: tagged framework version via git tag + `npm pack`-style tarball, or a git submodule. Record in decisions.md.

Framework packaging: `framework/cli/axf.mjs pack-framework <tag>` producing `axf-framework-<tag>.tgz` (core, react, ui, schemas, libs, plan cores) + a GitHub release asset on tag push (`release.yml`).

Repo split: create `MossesX/axf-console` (exists on GitHub first), move `apps/console-web` with history (`git subtree split`), manifest `location` + `repo.exists: true`, `_claude/` + CLAUDE.md via `claude-project`; CI there re-bakes from the tagged tarball instead of `../../framework`.

This repo: `apps/console-web` becomes a thin pointer (README + manifest `location` pointing at the new repo), `install-console.sh` clones the console repo; `deploy/` scripts and `android.yml` console job updated.
Verify: console builds in its repo against the tag, deploy on the VPS from the new clone, `/api/health` + `/mcp` ok; status + `build_step complete`.

Reuse `x.assets.templates` output: the 10 layouts, 10 light/dark pairs and 10 style packs are the showcase packs; add `showcase: true` tags in `framework/assets/templates/index.json` for the chosen 30 and a `packs.json` grouping them (`showcase-packs@1`).

Demo app: `apps/demo` re-baked (older framework!) and given a Showcase view that lists packs and swaps all three (layout, colour pair, style) at once (`rt.swap` ×3), with a thumbnail per pack from `template-shots`.
Android console showcase: same Showcase screen in `apps/console` (Compose) reading the bundled packs; thumbnails from the same shots.
Deploy + status: demo deploy green on `axf.amberxai.com`, Android APK in CI, status.json + tracker, `build_step complete`.
Polish pass on the phone: BRETT checks each pack on the S26 Ultra and the web; fix the ones that read badly (contrast/spacing) in the template files.
Docs: README "Showcase packs", screenshots in `_claude/memory/docs/showcase-packs.md`.

Scaffold: `axf new-library media --template device-capability --ports android,web,python` → `framework/android/lib-media`, `framework/libs/media`, `framework/python/axf_libs/media` (python = contract + placeholder); `axf compile-library media` passes; `libraries.json` entry; settings group (no own settings screen, rule).
Android `MediaPlayer` service (ExoPlayer/Media3 behind the kernel seam `axf.media`): play/pause/seek, playlist, background playback through `x.work`/foreground service; `MediaScreen` route `media`.
Android camera + capture (CameraX behind `axf.camera`): preview composable, photo/video capture into app files; permissions through the platform seam.
Streaming: HLS/RTSP sources + the VPS stream case (`c.vpsstream`: a Coolify-hosted stream URL from settings), reconnect rules; web uses `<video>` + hls.js only when needed.

Demo app: `axf init apps/demo-media --template android-compose --boilerplate <closest>` + `axf install media` with the library's screens in its nav; web demo page in `apps/demo` behind a nav entry; APK via `android.yml` (app-bundle finds it).

Tests + status: Kotlin unit tests (`:lib-media:testDebugUnitTest`, fake providers), web `check-media.mts` where a fixture exists, CI lines; status.json features dv.media, dv.stream, c.video, c.vpsstream → built, tracker, `build_step complete`; written without a compiler for Kotlin.

Scaffold: `axf new-library location --template device-capability --ports android,web,python` → `framework/android/lib-location`, `framework/libs/location`, `framework/python/axf_libs/location` (python = contract + placeholder); `axf compile-library location` passes; `libraries.json` entry; settings group (no own settings screen, rule).
Android location (fused provider behind `axf.location`): current fix, updates with accuracy/interval, permission flow; web `navigator.geolocation` with the same `LocationFix` shape.

Maps: a `map` widget kind (open registry) with a provider interface (`MapProvider`: tiles, markers, polyline); first providers: OSM tiles on web (Leaflet), Google Maps Compose on Android behind the seam.
Trails: record a track (list of fixes) to app files, show as polyline, export GPX; demo screen.

Demo app: `axf init apps/demo-location --template android-compose --boilerplate <closest>` + `axf install location` with the library's screens in its nav; web demo page in `apps/demo` behind a nav entry; APK via `android.yml` (app-bundle finds it).

Tests + status: Kotlin unit tests (`:lib-location:testDebugUnitTest`, fake providers), web `check-location.mts` where a fixture exists, CI lines; status.json features dv.loc, dv.maps, c.gps → built, tracker, `build_step complete`; written without a compiler for Kotlin.

Scaffold: `axf new-library editor --template feature-screens --ports android,web,python` → `framework/android/lib-editor`, `framework/libs/editor`, `framework/python/axf_libs/editor` (python = contract + placeholder); `axf compile-library editor` passes; `libraries.json` entry; settings group (no own settings screen, rule).
Editor contract `core/editor.ts` = Kotlin (document model, selection, undo, formats: plain/markdown/rich/code with language id), fixture `editor.json` for the markdown ↔ model round trip.
Web editors: markdown (textarea + preview), code (CodeMirror 6 reading theme tokens), rich text (contenteditable minimal) — all `--fx-*` tokens only; `check-theme.mjs` passes.
Android editors: Compose `BasicTextField`-based markdown + code (syntax colouring from a small tokenizer in the kernel), rich text minimal; `EditorScreen` route `editor`.

Demo app: `axf init apps/demo-editor --template android-compose --boilerplate <closest>` + `axf install editor` with the library's screens in its nav; web demo page in `apps/demo` behind a nav entry; APK via `android.yml` (app-bundle finds it).

Tests + status: Kotlin unit tests (`:lib-editor:testDebugUnitTest`, fake providers), web `check-editor.mts` where a fixture exists, CI lines; status.json features ui.editor, c.texteditor → built, tracker, `build_step complete`; written without a compiler for Kotlin.

Scaffold: `axf new-library ai --template integration --ports android,web,python` → `framework/android/lib-ai`, `framework/libs/ai`, `framework/python/axf_libs/ai` (python = contract + placeholder); `axf compile-library ai` passes; `libraries.json` entry; settings group (no own settings screen, rule).

Scope: lib-ai = the app-side assistant UI on `assistant@1` (`framework/core/assistant.ts`, `AssistantClient`) + lib-mcp for tools; no new provider code. Web: chat view library `framework/libs/ai` wrapping `HttpAssistantClient` + `watchReply` (from the ai-assistant plugin's reference routes), Settings → AI group (host URL, profile).
Android: `lib-ai` `AssistantScreen` (route `assistant`) on the Kotlin `AssistantClient` (SSE via lib-mcp's parser), live replies, stop, history; keys never in the app (host-side).
MCP tools in chat: tool rounds shown with the lib-mcp effects gate (destructive confirm card) on both ports; demo app wires the console's assistant host.

Demo app: `axf init apps/demo-ai --template android-compose --boilerplate <closest>` + `axf install ai` with the library's screens in its nav; web demo page in `apps/demo` behind a nav entry; APK via `android.yml` (app-bundle finds it).

Tests + status: Kotlin unit tests (`:lib-ai:testDebugUnitTest`, fake providers), web `check-ai.mts` where a fixture exists, CI lines; status.json features w.ai, w.mcp, c.ai → built, tracker, `build_step complete`; written without a compiler for Kotlin.

Scaffold: `axf new-library vps --template integration --ports android,web,python` → `framework/android/lib-vps`, `framework/libs/vps`, `framework/python/axf_libs/vps` (python = contract + placeholder); `axf compile-library vps` passes; `libraries.json` entry; settings group (no own settings screen, rule).

Contract: `VpsProvider` (hosts, run command through axHub `vps.run` with approvals, status) + `DeployProvider` (Coolify apps: list, deploy, logs) in `core/vps.ts` = Kotlin; everything goes through axHub (`lib-hub` client), never direct SSH from an app.
Web + Android screens: Hosts (status, doctor report from `console-doctor.sh --report` via the console API), Deploys (Coolify apps, Deploy now with approval link), logs tail; tokens only server-side.
Demo: ShipX-style wizard screen (pick project → home → deploy) as the demo app, reusing project-wizard homes through the console API.

Demo app: `axf init apps/demo-vps --template android-compose --boilerplate <closest>` + `axf install vps` with the library's screens in its nav; web demo page in `apps/demo` behind a nav entry; APK via `android.yml` (app-bundle finds it).
